raw:
The design uses 10 edits with 10 parents each. Within each block the parents form matched pairs that differ only at one candidate condition edge. The condition edges cover the op that gets replaced, whether node 1 or node 2 is disconnected, and whether edges 3, 5, 0 and 2 are none, skip or conv.

| Experiments | Edit | Conditions varied in the parent |
|---|---|---|
| 1–10 | edge 5 → conv3x3 | edge 1, edge 2, edge 3 |
| 11–20 | edge 3 → skip | edge 5, edge 4, op replaced |
| 21–30 | edge 0 → conv3x3 | edges 2 and 4 (node 1 dead or alive), op replaced |
| 31–40 | edge 4 → conv3x3 | edge 0, edges 3 and 5 |
| 41–50 | edge 1 → avg_pool | op replaced, edge 2, edge 3 |
| 51–60 | edge 5 → none | edge 3, edge 4, op replaced |
| 61–70 | edge 2 → conv3x3 | edge 0, edge 1, edge 5 |
| 71–80 | edge 3 → conv3x3 | edge 5, op replaced |
| 81–90 | edge 0 → skip | edges 2 and 4, op replaced, edge 3 |
| 91–100 | edge 5 → avg_pool | op replaced, edge 3, node 2 dead |
